answer.label: quantized
answer.justification: Only logit-level values were measured. KL 0.032 and TV 0.043 are the lowest among the non-base categories, near or just below the quantized range (KL 0.039–0.071, TV 0.048–0.055), and below the fine-tuned (KL 0.081+) and system-prompted (KL 0.197+) ranges. Top-1 agreement of 0.943 is close to the quantized range (0.945–0.955) and above the system-prompted range (0.861–0.908). Token-DiFR gap 0.044 and raw-score shift ÷ TV of 2.6 are also close to the quantized values (0.03–0.04 and 2.2–2.3). Fine-tuned is the main alternative: its top-1 agreement range (0.900–0.938) sits just below 0.943, but its KL and TV are too high and its raw-score ratio is typically larger. Base is ruled out because every difference is non-zero. Sequence agreement of 0.625 is a bit below the quantized range (0.67–0.70), which is consistent with single-draw variation.
